intended_object: A local type abbreviation for the points of the lifted domain, `PressureStream.Lift Plane = ℝ × (Plane × Plane)` with `Plane = ℝ × ℝ` (a time coordinate together with two planar coordinates). It is used as shorthand inside this file of a large Navier–Stokes construction.
explanation: The declaration only renames a product type for the library's own use. It unfolds to `ℝ × ((ℝ × ℝ) × (ℝ × ℝ))`, built from `PressureStream.Lift (S : Type) := ℝ × (S × Plane)` and `Plane := ℝ × ℝ`. It adds no mathematical content of its own: it does not formalize a standard notion from the literature. It is an implementation convenience that names the domain of the lifted functions in this proof development, so there is no textbook object to compare it with.
